title: Playing in the same brass band as Louis; meeting in Chicago
summary: Punch and Louis played in the same brass band; they met in Chicago after Punch left New Orleans in 1927, and Louis put him with a band on Sundays.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, how about that? We can get on to it, but you got all that stuff.
Yeah, but we don't know about you and Louis. That's the thing she wants to know.
She might put your picture in a magazine. You'll be rich and famous. Yeah, well, no.
More than we used to play in the same brass band.
You didn't know him in Chicago or technical?

No, no. Oh, yeah. I thought, he lived in 26, I think. And I left here in 1927. Uh-huh. Well, we'd meet on the street like that and talk. And sometime he'd tell me he had a few jobs or something like that. He'd put me with a band. I played every Sunday with that band. There's two brothers of them. I can't call their name. Was that near the Vendal?
That's what I told you about. Near the Vendal.
